import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
import math

img80 = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0080.png"))
# In obs_0080, cam pose is (-0.2866, 4.5427), theta = 180 deg
# Let find the lamp base contact with the floor
# Mask the base:
mask = (img80[:,:,0] > 60) & (img80[:,:,0] < 110) & (img80[:,:,1] > 70) & (img80[:,:,1] < 120) & (img80[:,:,2] > 80) & (img80[:,:,2] < 140)

u_bottom_mean = bottom_pts[:,1].mean()
print(f"Bottom contact: v={v_max}, u_mean={u_bottom_mean}")

pts78 = np.argwhere(mask78)
print("obs_0078 lamp base:")
print(f"u in [{pts78[:,1].min()}, {pts78[:,1].max()}], v in [{pts78[:,0].min()}, {pts78[:,0].max()}]")
bottom_78 = pts78[pts78[:,0] == pts78[:,0].max()]
print(f"Bottom contact 78: v={pts78[:,0].max()}, u_mean={bottom_78[:,1].mean()}")
